method: Paired flag-off/flag-on observations using released Cookbook.search and MealModel.suggestMeal. Search uses the page's model-computed ready set. Each fixture starts without a selected menu or adjustments.

fixture.units: Catalog base units, grams or pieces; one-unit is deliberately one base unit, not one serving.
fixture.ample: All quantities at the maximum; no estimates.
fixture.one-unit: Only the target ingredient is reduced to one base unit.
fixture.zero: Only the target ingredient is set to zero, with its priority flag still toggled.
fixture.estimated: All quantities at the maximum; only the target is marked estimated.
